name: Levi Maua Gerard Casas
original_name: レヴィ・マウア・ジェラード・カサス
source:
Las Casas's grandson, a very young Dylas-Leen's Air Guild mechanic, so hardworking and brilliant to became a Scholar at a very young age.
He has a crush on Shella.
